translations.web: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
translations.bsb: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
translations.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
translations.asv: If any man loveth not the Lord, let him be anathema. Maranatha.
